The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError because cells H46 through L47 contained '#NAME?' instead of the expected numerical values. This indicates that the generated Excel workbook uses functions or named ranges that are not recognized by the evaluator. While basic structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical calculations for 'net metric' and 'statistics' matrices are broken. Avoid using unsupported Excel functions or ensure all named ranges are correctly defined in the 'Task' worksheet.
